## Deployment behavior

Portal retains deploy-cloudflare-pages.yml dispatch. Gesher dashboard gains workflow_dispatch and dispatch after an approved merge because GITHUB_TOKEN merges do not trigger push workflows; its Worker API deployment remains manual and such PRs must contain Release: manual. WhatsApp has no deployment workflow in its current base; merges do not add SSH/service deployment. Finance/admin retain their existing external Pages deployment flow. Follow-up function/database/deployment work must remain Release: manual.

## Rollback

Nizan holds/pauses releases through the normal admin controls, then uses a reviewed revert PR. Keep required release-window bound to the App; do not restore a GITHUB_TOKEN writer or Any source, and do not bypass protection. Preserve secrets/installation until no workflow needs them; remove only through a separate authorized settings change. Never fake a sync timestamp. No rollback action has been executed.
